scenario: 同一节目人物/字幕/语音

scope.this_run: B/C bounded local implementation; Linux browser and actual local providers; no Windows/platform acceptance

state_semantics.playing: WebAudio running and media.play success precede receipt; local media observation only
state_semantics.completed: media ended then accepted receipt; lost receipt remains unconfirmed; no viewer proof
state_semantics.cancelled_expired_failed: media/caption/mouth cleared; epoch and playback generation reject stale callbacks

whitelist_constraints: text only after explicit per-job approval
question only if deliberately included in approved scene
do not forward material/topic/recent or owner state wholesale
expires_at is server monotonic time, not browser Date.now
never expose output token or private cookie

B.start_condition: user authorized bounded technical implementation; implemented

C.start_condition: B interface frozen; implemented in separate files

handoff.room: private preview remains separate; v1 fixed right-character/left-caption transparent program
handoff.parallel_rule: B/C only after contract freeze, separate files; backend/output requests go through B

acceptance.pass_condition: 一条演练从收到到停止的主播/布置/节目职责可辨
acceptance.required_evidence: 现有两个输出入口与单一目标场景对照
acceptance.status: 技术职责已落实，视觉待认可

acceptance.pass_condition: 现有字段、建议新增字段和未知明确分开
acceptance.required_evidence: B确认字段映射与作用域，不另起并行队列

acceptance.pass_condition: 公开快照白名单成立，私聊/草稿/密钥不透传
acceptance.required_evidence: 私密金丝雀、令牌资源范围与未批准反例
acceptance.status: 开发白名单/权限与反例通过

acceptance.pass_condition: 同一job的批准文本/角色/字幕/实际音轨一致
acceptance.required_evidence: 双端完整录像、音轨、快照hash与事件时间线
acceptance.status: 同版真实provider完整媒体通过；非观众证据

acceptance.pass_condition: playing回执不能早于实际媒体活动证明
acceptance.required_evidence: audio.play拒绝/解码错误/晚回执故障注入
acceptance.status: 旧红/新拒绝与实际媒体通过

acceptance.pass_condition: 取消/过期/切身份/话题后不能复活或补播
acceptance.required_evidence: 旧令牌、晚模型/音频响应与重连反例
acceptance.status: 终态竞态旧红/新绿，晚结果不复活

acceptance.pass_condition: 主信息优先、停止可找、终态和错误恢复持续可见
acceptance.required_evidence: 同任务操作记录、键盘与低频布置后置对照
acceptance.status: 局部更新与实际宿主加载恢复通过；真人收益待验证

acceptance.pass_condition: 30秒期限不被放宽；先基线后固定延迟/中断阈值
acceptance.required_evidence: 分阶段与受控负载时间线，标明时钟域
acceptance.status: 30秒不变；WAV准入与过期拒绝通过；长题/负载失败保留

acceptance.pass_condition: 用户明确审阅唯一任务的布局方向
acceptance.required_evidence: 审阅记录与状态联系表，不以色板/测试数量代替

acceptance.pass_condition: Windows/实际设备音频/独立审美不由AI自检顶替
acceptance.required_evidence: 同版候选包后执行外部固定任务

verification_this_run.status: final local source gate and actual media verified; long-input/load failures retained
verification_this_run.limits: Linux synthetic local event/real provider; not Windows/native installation/viewer/human learning or visual acceptance
